result:
I’ll trace scorer reconstruction, executor startup, and guardrail loading, then add the server-side restriction and targeted tests. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill for these changes.

There are already staged regression tests for this change; I’ll preserve them and implement against them. The code confirms that scorer reconstruction currently executes source, and guardrail loading catches all errors and skips the guardrail. Custom-code rejection needs to propagate instead.

Custom scorers now load as inert metadata in the server, and the reconstruction method itself refuses to execute their source. Job subprocesses get explicit execution permission, which server startup clears. I’m finishing guardrail rejection for both standalone custom scorers and ensembles containing them.

The selected server-startup, guardrail-creation, and HTTP 500 tests passed their assertions, including workspace-enabled cases. Pytest then hit a sandbox restriction while inspecting child processes during teardown. I’ve added coverage for nested custom scorers and signatures that would execute code during loading, and I’m checking those next.

The focused scorer and guardrail checks now pass, including metadata round-tripping, client and executor reconstruction, and built-in and judge compatibility. The broader run also encountered trace-collection failures and a job-runner timeout; I’m doing a final check of executor permission and direct server startup before wrapping up.

Implemented inert custom-scorer loading in the server, with execution blocked at reconstruction. Clients retain existing behavior; job subprocesses explicitly enable execution, and server startup clears inherited permission.

Gateway guardrails now reject custom scorers, including nested ensembles. Existing unsupported guardrails fail requests with HTTP 500 naming the guardrail; other loading errors remain logged and skipped.

Added regression coverage. Focused assertions passed, but pytest teardown hit a sandbox process-inspection restriction. A broader relevant run also encountered tracing failures and a job timeout. No dependencies were installed or full suite run.
